text: Look at the question at the top of the screen. Read it carefully, then find the matching word on a falling apple.
Move your body left, center, or right to guide your basket. Catch the apple with the correct word. You've got this!
In Seconds mode, you have sixty seconds. Catch as many correct words as you can before the timer reaches zero!
In Lives mode, you start with three hearts. Catching a wrong apple costs one heart, so look carefully before you move.
Every correct apple earns one hundred points! A wrong answer never takes away points you have already earned. Keep trying!
Need a little break? Press Pause to stop for a moment. Press Resume when you're ready to play again!
Read the grammar question on the screen. Look at each balloon, then choose the one with the word that answers the question.
Move your body left, center, or right to aim. Start with your hands lowered, then raise either hand to shoot. Keep your hand raised to fire again after a short cooldown!
In Seconds mode, you have sixty seconds. Pop as many balloons with correct answers as you can before time runs out!
In Lives mode, you have three hearts. Popping a wrong balloon can cost one heart. Take your time and choose carefully!
Each correct balloon adds one hundred points! A wrong balloon never takes away the points you've already earned. Great work!
Want a quick rest? Press Pause to take a break. Press Resume when you're ready to pop more balloons!
Read the question before your flight. Three word gates are coming toward you. Choose the correct word and fly through the center of its ring!
Spread both arms wide like airplane wings. Step left, center, or right to steer. Lower either arm to freeze your plane. Spread both arms again to keep flying!
Look at the colored rings ahead. Fly through the ring with the correct grammar answer to earn points. Aim for the middle of the opening!
In Seconds mode, you have sixty seconds. Fly through as many correct rings as you can before the timer reaches zero!
In Lives mode, you start with three hearts. A wrong ring or a missed answer can cost one heart. Choose your gate carefully!
Fly through the correct ring to earn one hundred points! A wrong answer never removes your earned points. Keep your eyes on the next gate!
Need to rest your arms? Press Pause for a quick break. Press Resume when you're ready to fly again!
